summary: Code review PASS. Implementation is clean, minimal, and consistent with all existing patterns in load_config(). One Fix-Forward applied: promoted the inline _TRUTHY set to a module-level frozenset constant _CAPTURE_DIALOGUES_TRUTHY, matching the style of _ANTHROPIC_PREFIXES/_GOOGLE_PREFIXES. All 66 tests pass after the fix.

comments.note: No blocking issues found. Implementation follows the established env-var parsing pattern (os.environ.get → .strip().lower() → membership test) consistently with all other fields in load_config().

Promoted `_TRUTHY = {"true", "1", "yes"}` from a local variable inside load_config() to a module-level frozenset `_CAPTURE_DIALOGUES_TRUTHY`. Rationale: module-level private constants (e.g. _ANTHROPIC_PREFIXES, _GOOGLE_PREFIXES) are the established pattern; a local variable is invisible to readers scanning the module's constants section. Change is non-behavioral — same membership test, same values. 66 tests continue to pass.

The new `CAPTURE_DIALOGUES` environment variable and its accepted values (`true`, `1`, `yes`) are not yet mentioned in any README or environment variable reference doc. The Documentation agent should add an entry for `CAPTURE_DIALOGUES` alongside the existing env var table (MODEL_NAME, MAX_ITERATIONS, etc.) to ensure operators know how to enable dialogue capture.
